summary: Regression sweep after code-review fixes (backend _bucket_start refactor, env-configurable demo creds, AuthContext warnings, ThemeContext memoization, Toaster module scope, Ledgerly -> iEXPENSES rename). All 26/26 backend pytest cases passed, including OCR live Gemini 3 flash call, analytics for all 4 periods (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly) still returning identical shape with keys total_all_time/current_period_total/period/trend/category_breakdown/recent/weekly_bars/transaction_count/currency, and Emergent OAuth /api/auth/session invalid-id -> 401. Frontend Playwright regression: login+signup render, title is 'iEXPENSES - Personal Expense Tracker', brand text 'iEXPENSES' appears on Login/Signup/Sidebar, demo login -> dashboard with all 4 stat cards and 4 chart panels, expense create via sidebar-add-expense-btn persists (verified via /transactions filter), transactions filters + edit + delete confirmed, analytics daily/weekly/monthly/yearly toggles all clickable, profile save works, theme-dark/theme-light-btn flips html root class dark<->light, both profile-logout-btn and sidebar-logout-btn navigate to /login. Zero console errors. Zero regressions.

issues: Same as iteration 1 - recharts still emits 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on mount. Non-blocking, charts render correctly. Suggest passing minWidth={0} or mount-guard.

action_items: (Optional / pre-existing, not a regression) Dashboard recent-expenses-panel does not refresh immediately after ExpenseModal save from sidebar/topbar; it only refreshes on the 30s polling interval. Consider passing an onSaved callback from Layout's ExpenseModal to trigger a global refresh or use React Query invalidation. Persistence itself works (verified via /transactions search).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _bucket_start refactor is safe - `b = dt` initialization before conditional reassignment does not change any output because every code path either reassigns b or, for period='yearly', still returns str(b.year) equivalent to dt.year (since b=dt at that point; but note the yearly branch DOES reassign b to Jan 1). All 4 period tests still pass identically.
ThemeContext memoization via useMemo is correct - value only changes when [theme, toggle] change; toggle is inside setter reference so identity is stable.
AuthContext empty-catch now console.warn - improves debuggability without behavior change.
Toaster options extracted to module scope - avoids re-creating object on every App render; correct optimization.
Brand rename 'iEXPENSES' consistently applied across Layout.jsx (sidebar + mobile drawer + brand cell), Login.jsx, Signup.jsx, and public/index.html <title>.
